summary: This maintenance release completes the update footer and fixes dismissal of optional update notices.
changelog: Centered each icon-and-label group inside the three update footer buttons.
Added standard theme icons to Download new version, Not now, and Close application.
Fixed Not now so it dismisses an optional update notice immediately.
Fixed the title-bar close button so it dismisses optional notices through the same lifecycle path.
Preserved the mandatory-update policy: closing a required notice still requests a safe application exit.
Added regression coverage for button alignment, action icons, and optional-window close behavior.
